sources.snippet: Overview Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct is an instruction-tuned multilingual large language model with 8 billion parameters developed by meta-llama. It is designed for multilingual dialogue and assistant-like chat applications, built on an auto-regressive transformer architecture with Grouped-Query Attention (GQA) for improved inference scalability.
